fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-11-19, around 20:05, a caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 75,000 was withdrawn, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-11-19. Saravanan Gopal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000094. The account reference SYN-ACC-100084 was noted in connection with the payment. A witness, Ramya Bai, reachable on 9000000232, was mentioned in the complaint. A person named Sathish Ramasamy, associated with the number 9000000209, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned digital documents, a bank transaction reference and a call detail reference.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Digital document; Bank transaction reference; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent KYC-update message allegedly used to collect account credentials.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, evening, receiving account, apartment complex, witness, bank reference, mobile number
